drawing.prompt_text: Sketch the 3-stage pixel pipeline: box 1 labeled IN with [255, 128, 0], box 2 labeled MATH with ÷255 per channel, box 3 labeled OUT with [1.0, 0.50196, 0.0]. Arrows left to right, one clean sketch, no stray marks.

hints: Name each box before drawing arrows — IN, MATH, OUT.
Predict the OUT values first (1.0, 0.50196, 0.0), then sketch.
Inspect before submitting: exactly one sketch, values matching the example.
